# Dutaly

> Dutaly is an AI helpdesk that turns customer emails into structured tickets and replies automatically using your knowledge base.

Dutaly connects to Gmail or any IMAP/SMTP inbox, classifies incoming email, drafts grounded replies from your knowledge base, and escalates anything risky or angry to a human. Built for small support teams that want to scale without hiring.
